welcome.label: 👋 Welcome message
welcome.description: Variables: {mention}, {username}, {server}, {count}. Sent when a member arrives.

enabled.label: Enable the welcome message
enabled.help: Off, no arrival is announced — the settings below are kept for the day you turn it back on. The module needs the privileged « Server Members » intent: without it the bot is never told about arrivals and nothing is sent, with no visible error.

channelId.label: Channel
channelId.help: The channel the message is posted in. The bot must be able to write there, and to attach a file if the image card is on. Empty, nothing is sent.

message.label: Message
message.help: Variables replaced when sent: {mention} addresses the member (and pings them), {username} gives their name without pinging, {server} the server name, {count} the member count after they joined.

embed.label: Show as an embed
embed.help: Puts the text in a coloured box rather than a plain message. An embed does not trigger a mention notification: putting {mention} in one shows the name but does not ping the member.

footer.label: Footer (embed)
footer.help: Small grey line under the box — rules to read, an introductions channel. Only shown when the embed is on.

card.label: Image card (avatar + name)
card.help: The bot draws an image with the member's avatar and name, and attaches it. More eye-catching, but heavier: avoid it on a server where arrivals come dozens per hour.

cardBackground.label: Card background image (URL)
cardBackground.help: Background image for the card, a publicly reachable PNG or JPEG. Empty, a plain background is used. An unreachable URL breaks nothing: the bot falls back to the plain background.

leave.label: 🚪 Goodbye message
leave.description: Variables: {username}, {server}. Sent when a member leaves.

enabled.label: Enable the goodbye message
enabled.help: Off, departures go unnoticed. The bot cannot tell someone leaving from someone being removed: on a server that removes people regularly, that is often the setting you want.

channelId.label: Channel
channelId.help: The channel the message is posted in. A staff-only channel avoids showing every departure to everyone. Empty, nothing is sent.

message.label: Message
message.help: Variables replaced when sent: {username} for the leaver's name, {server} for the server name. No {mention} here: someone who has left can no longer be mentioned.

embed.label: Show as an embed
embed.help: Puts the text in a coloured box rather than a plain message.

footer.label: Footer (embed)
footer.help: Small grey line under the box. Only shown when the embed is on.

card.label: Image card (avatar + name)
card.help: The bot draws an image with the leaver's avatar and name. The avatar comes from the cache: one for a member long gone may be missing, and the card stays generic.

cardBackground.label: Card background image (URL)
cardBackground.help: Background image for the card, a publicly reachable PNG or JPEG. Empty, a plain background is used.
